test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 08 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98fa12b7b29ba8d5f3fb19fe47090d049e287287b8e377a24e728d15dd3c7a32.png]
solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

**The figure moves in clockwise direction pointing towards the corners.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/577c5620c3867a3bce24ca27be588d893aa7e0d88407afbe4a256a00afedd26c.png] 

**The letters are in alphabetical order where every third letter is skipped, the letters move in clockwise direction**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64e3d4a8f2b2304a614b18f48b132dd99b8c9417b58f611af766a0fa26b2d22c.png] 

Next step: 

**The alphabets will be L and M. M will be on top left & L will be on bottom right.**

**The head of the figure will point towards bottom right corner.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ecbb99157d2c7bb45a67becdc0f99ee80b05ecd8a40440731c384164344aab9.png] 

Now we consider the given options:

Option 1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/760c9eb6561584b0331fafaba03d4f85cd545b3684417ecbbcda80f6e58a2964.png] The positions of alphabets is interchanged.

Option 2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63e8e200c7ec663edeb5176ec20a34152752eabd4b02598f45c1e8c0f2f57b34.png] The position of alphabets & the figure is incorrect.

Option 3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ead0271b0efc6f1c16093c2435e4d5a6a03d792644d2fc433bc0b89f811ecb79.png] The positioning of the figure is incorrect.

Option 4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ecbb99157d2c7bb45a67becdc0f99ee80b05ecd8a40440731c384164344aab9.png] The pattern is correct.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
